immunABC Vaccination Schedule

Source: R/immunABC.schedule.R
immunABC.schedule.Rd

A dataset containing the vaccination schedule for each vaccine dose. Each row specifies the target population for a given dose.

Usage

immunABC.schedule

Format

A data frame with X rows and 4 variables:

dose

The name of the vaccine dose.

age_schedule

The age of the target population for that dose (in days).

age_schedule_low

The lower limit to consider that dose valid when applied (in days).

age_schedule_high

The upper limit to consider that dose valid when applied (in days).

Source

immunABC
